title: Landslide Control - Guidelines
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the guidelines for selection of various landslide control methods for effective correction measures to avoid landslides in hill areas.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Subsurface investigation for foundations Code of practice second revision of IS 1892
Classification and identification of soils for general engineering purposes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
